129.name: Resident extension
129.description: Always-resident HG-Engine hooks, shared helpers and custom gameplay code.

130.name: Battle extension
130.description: Custom battle engine logic loaded with vanilla battle overlay 12.

131.name: Field extension
131.description: Overworld extension, encounter and evolution data, ecology generation and Apricorn crafting.

133.name: Field evolution service
133.description: Evolution target resolution, early-item requirements and compatibility labels in field contexts.

134.name: Battle evolution service
134.description: Evolution service variant for battle and overlapping-menu contexts.

135.name: Move / defender ability checks
135.description: Checks move interactions with the defender’s abilities.

136.name: Switch-in ability checks
136.description: Processes ability effects when Pokémon enter battle.

137.name: Battle stat-change command
137.description: Handles battle script command 33 for stat changes.

138.name: Damage calculation
138.description: Calculates move damage with stats, power, abilities and item modifiers.

139.name: Battle form-change checks
139.description: Checks and schedules Pokémon form changes during battle.

140.name: Defender item-effect checks
140.description: Checks the defender’s held-item effects after an attack.

141.name: End-of-turn effects
141.description: Processes weather, residual damage, healing and expiring effects.

142.name: Before-move battle controller
142.description: Coordinates the battle controller before a move executes.

143.name: Battle message buffering
143.description: Builds and buffers battle message parameters.

144.name: Move-end battle controller
144.description: Coordinates battle processing at the end of a move.

145.name: HP calculation
145.description: Battle HP change calculation and processing.

146.name: Before-action processing
146.description: Battle server checks before an action.

147.name: Post-move effects
147.description: Processes effects after a move executes.

148.name: Capture calculation
148.description: Calculates Poké Ball shake and capture results.

149.name: Party item use
149.description: Applies items to Pokémon from the party interface.

151.name: Trade Pokémon creation
151.description: Creates the received Pokémon for a trade.

152.name: Wild encounter generation
152.description: Temporary service for ecology selection, distance caps, stage adjustment, held items, wild-mon creation and Bug-Catching Contest generation. Unloaded before returning to battle transition. Mom world generation remains in 131.
